scripts.push: vite build && git add . && git commit -m 'Stage all changes, commit and push' && git push
scripts.deploy: ssh -t artgarden 'cd public_html/artgarden && git pull origin main && composer install --no-dev --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader && php83-cli artisan config:clear && php83-cli artisan cache:clear && php83-cli artisan route:clear && php83-cli artisan view:clear && exec bash'
